description: This file defines a PHP class InboundEmailViewList that extends a base view class, configuring list view behaviors for inbound emails in the SuiteCRM application. It includes logic to prepare the list view by disabling export and empty data messages.

classes.name: InboundEmailViewList
classes.description: A PHP class for managing the list view of inbound emails in SuiteCRM, customizing list view preparation.

methods.name: listViewPrepare
methods.description: Prepares the list view by calling parent method, disabling export, and hiding empty data messages.
